task_definition.task_description: Please check the status of my living room light, then set its brightness to 70 by turning it on in warm white. After that, check the current BTC price and my checking account balance, then place a buy order for 250.5. Next, get the latest AAPL quote and archive that quote snapshot for me, then generate an invoice for 1 Sony XM5 black using the SAVE15 coupon with PayPal sent to alice@company.com, and finally create a medium-priority app document and alert titled "IoT Update and Purchase Summary" using the invoice message.

user_input.query: Please check the status of my living room light light_living and its brightness property, then turn it on with brightness 70 (device value 70) in warm_white. After that, check the current BTC price in USD and my checking account balance for user_123, then place a buy order for 250.5. Next, get the latest AAPL quote and archive that quote snapshot under the title Trade Quote Archive. Then generate an invoice for 1 of product p_sony_xm5_blk, which is 1 Sony XM5 black, using the SAVE15 coupon and PayPal, and send it to alice@company.com. Finally, use the invoice message to create a medium-priority app document and alert titled IoT Update and Purchase Summary on the app channel.
